checkedAlternates.risk: Tetanus is an acute neuromuscular toxin disease.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Tetanus enters directly via contaminated skin wounds from soil spores (group-1), not via biting arthropod vectors (group-3).

checkedAlternates.risk: Typhoid fever causes high fever and systemic illness.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Typhoid is transmitted by contaminated water and food (group-2), not respiratory aerosols (group-4).
